study.question: Fixed b2/b4 held-out context transfer beyond the earlier three-file public smoke cohort
study.selection: Availability-selected public CC0 inputs, previously used for other public measurements; not random or pristine held-out research samples
study.primary_criterion: Both b2_two and b4_one gain_vs_empty_bits > 0 and strictly exceed their own 16-permutation mean gain
study.secondary_criterion: Report signed previous-model loss minus larger-model loss for b2_five and b4_two, and own16-permutation mean; no primary rescue
limitations: Adjacent train/test blocks may be dependent
Selective whole-block escape omission and unknown post-escape framing
Descriptive comparisons, not significance or uncertainty
Historical private cohort and complete estimator unavailable
No deeper-chain, parity-invariance, GF(2), causal or decoder claim
